description: Pinned response shapes for the Linq B2B endpoints that the fake provider implements. The fake must serve responses whose fields are a superset of the shapes listed here — any field present in a shape must appear in the fake's response with the same type. Provenance is recorded per endpoint so a reviewer can trace each shape back to its source.
note: No NIN, no API key, no real customer reference appears anywhere in this file. Fake identifiers use the prefix 'fake_' or obviously synthetic values.

POST /b2b/customers.source: Linq B2B API reference, /b2b/customers provisioning endpoint. The response shape was cross-checked against observed behaviour logged during W090 testing (2026-10-14): a first call returns created:true and the reference, a repeat call returns created:false and the reference unchanged.

POST /b2b/offramp.source: Linq B2B API reference, /b2b/offramp order creation endpoint. Fields id, walletAddress, coinType, coin, chain, amountStableCoin, amountNGN, rate, currency and status are all documented. The idempotencyKey deduplication behaviour (same key → same order) was documented and additionally confirmed in W090 testing.

POST /b2b/onramp.source: Linq B2B API reference, /b2b/onramp order creation endpoint. Fields orderId, customerRef, accountNumber, bankName, accountName, amountNgn, amountStableCoin, fee, expiresAt and status are all documented. No idempotencyKey is sent or documented; each request is a new order.

POST /b2b/bills/pay.source: Linq B2B API reference, /b2b/bills/pay bill payment endpoint. Fields id, customerRef, wallet and status are documented. No idempotencyKey is sent or documented; each request is a new order.
